a.response: State preference scope explicitly, store presentation independently and keep all fields available in Details.
a.scoreReason: Personal emphasis preserves features but adds preference configuration and scope decisions.

b.attack: At 320px labelled date, count, duration and price fields stack into a tall metadata block per task.
b.response: Keep ledger alignment on wide views but disclose supplemental fields behind one local detail line on narrow views.
b.scoreReason: Single-material ledger reduces surface inflation, with clear responsive clutter repair.

revisedWinner.mechanism: Retain the flat ledger and single glass toolbar; use labelled aligned totals where space permits, replace narrow supplemental task fields with an expandable detail line, and preserve exact period, scope, all original field actions and menus.
revisedWinner.visible: Dates, count, duration and price in labeled aligned ledger fields. Exact reference period and current inclusion scope remain readable.
revisedWinner.disclosed: Field buttons reveal original editors and source breakdowns; scope selector, routine diagnostic and full menus remain in toolbar/section controls; supplemental metadata expands beneath task. Retain every existing editor, action, link, diagnostic and scoped menu without duplicating command menus.
revisedWinner.access: Use semantic buttons, 44px nonoverlapping targets, visible focus, keyboard disclosure, scope-specific names and focus return; disable scoped motion when requested. Minimum 44px targets; visible keyboard focus; no hover-only routes; wrap at 320/375px; scoped reduced motion.
